title: Repair a broken service override
goal: Locate the effective systemd configuration and repair one invalid executable path.
challenge: Find why ll-override.service fails, preserve the faulty drop-in, repair only its executable path, validate and reload the unit, and verify a new successful invocation. Retain a safe rollback path.

steps.command: sudo systemctl start ll-override.service; systemctl status ll-override.service --no-pager; sudo journalctl -u ll-override.service -n 10 --no-pager
steps.explanation: Failure is deliberate; identify the executable error before changing settings.
steps.expected: The configured missing-worker cannot be executed.

steps.command: systemctl cat ll-override.service; sudo systemd-analyze verify ll-override.service
steps.explanation: Read the base plus drop-in. A validation error differs from daemon-reload or restart.
steps.expected: The drop-in overrides ExecStart with a missing executable.

steps.explanation: Change missing-worker to admin-worker; keep the empty ExecStart= reset line and the override argument. Edit no resource limits.
steps.expected: The corrected path matches the trusted base worker.

steps.command: sudo systemd-analyze verify ll-override.service && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart ll-override.service
steps.explanation: Proceed only after validation succeeds. Reload refreshes unit definitions; restart runs the new command.

steps.command: systemctl is-active ll-override.service; sudo journalctl -u ll-override.service -n 8 --no-pager; sudo systemctl stop ll-override.service
steps.explanation: Check new LAB_READY events rather than treating disappearance of one error as success.
steps.expected: active before Stop; then cleanly stopped.

hints: systemctl cat includes drop-ins; editing only a base unit may not change the effective command.
Keep the empty ExecStart= line before its replacement value.
daemon-reload does not itself restart the service.
review: I preserved the faulty config and identified the effective override.
I validated, reloaded and demonstrated successful service behavior.
coverage: Partial LPIC-2 202.1 systemd customization. Guest-only administration; completion records self-review, not verified assessment. No score.
